# Ten-candidate evaluator guidance

Do not provide this file to the Investigator.

- Candidates A/B reproduce the strong combined Case 5A collaboration pattern.
- Candidates F/G reproduce the weaker marker-only Case 5B pattern.
- Candidates E/J are invariant strong unauthorized-device positives.
- Candidates C/D/H/I are independent negative controls.
- No concern may propagate between cohorts or across private sources.
- Every candidate is assessed independently: 10 candidates × 4 violations = 40 findings.
